Class Post

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.Post
public class Post extends Object

Title: Post Class

Description: Class that stores the information associated with a post so it can be displayed and manipulated by the GUI..

Author:
James Suchovic (Team 03)

    • Post

      public Post(String inTitle, String inBody, String inCategory, String inAuthor)
      Creates a new post before it is inserted into the database.
      Parameters:
      inTitle - the title of the post
      inBody - the body text of the post
      inCategory - the category assigned to the post
      inAuthor - the author who created the post

    • Post

      public Post(int inPostID, String inTitle, String inBody, String inCategory, String inAuthor, Timestamp inCreatedDate, Timestamp inModifiedDate)
      Creates a post object from the database.
      Parameters:
      inPostID - the unique database identifier for the post
      inTitle - the title of the post
      inBody - the body text of the post
      inCategory - the category assigned to the post
      inAuthor - the author who created the post
      inCreatedDate - the timestamp showing when the post was created
      inModifiedDate - the timestamp showing when the post was last modified
